Estacada, Oregon

Junk removal in Estacada

Estacada sits on the Clackamas River at the edge of the national forest, nineteen road miles out along Highway 224, which keeps it in Zone 2. Properties here are often larger, with shops, barns and river cabins alongside regular houses in town.

River and forest living fills sheds fast. We haul old camping gear, broken outdoor furniture, scrap wood, and household items from cabins being cleared out or sold. If your property is up a forest road, tell us and send a photo so we can plan the drive.

Estacada questions

Good to know

Can you clear out a cabin near Estacada?

Yes. Send photos of each room and the outside, and tell us how the road in looks. We price the whole cabin by load size.

Do you go up forest roads?

We can drive maintained gravel roads in good weather. Rough or snowy roads may mean meeting us at the pavement, so ask first.

Is there a travel charge to Estacada?

Yes. Estacada is in our zone 2, so travel adds $25.00 per visit to the load price. It is shown in your price before you book.

Which Estacada ZIP codes do you cover?

All of these: 97023. Type yours in the quote and the price includes travel.
